candidates.title: Calibrated latent-distribution Fin-JEPA for regime-specific abstention

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

candidates.mechanistic_bridge: Replace point latent prediction with a calibrated latent distribution and use context-only regime strata to test whether uncertainty supports abstention. Regime detection and multi-horizon prediction are controls inherited from Fin-JEPA future work; the distinct hypothesis is calibrated distributional uncertainty tied to risk-coverage.

falsifiable_test.design: Walk-forward equity and FX evaluation with regime labels fit inside each training fold; compare point JEPA, the paper's regime and multi-horizon future-work baseline, distributional JEPA, and calibrated abstention.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: out-of-sample latent negative log likelihood with calibration error
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if calibration or risk-coverage does not improve over point Fin-JEPA in held-out regimes.

candidates.title: Event-conditioned financial JEPA with causal relevance gating

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

candidates.mechanistic_bridge: Encode timestamp-safe earnings and dynamically selected exogenous context separately, open a relevance gate only when that context adds predictive information beyond price history, and train the gated context to predict future market latents across event-time windows. The causal relevance gate is imported from external GS-FUSE/CAMEF prior art and is not an approved-corpus fact.

falsifiable_test.design: Pre-register earnings and exogenous-data availability timestamps; compare price-only JEPA, unconditional fusion, relevance-gated fusion, and shuffled-event controls with purged walk-forward folds.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: event-window future-latent prediction gain over price-only JEPA
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if gains disappear against shuffled events or if the gate uses information unavailable at decision time.

candidates.title: Dual-target Fin-JEPA for raw dynamics and denoised market state

atypicality.interpretation: corpus rarity only; not novelty or value

candidates.mechanistic_bridge: Train one predictor against the ordinary future encoder latent and a second head against a denoised, volatility-aware state target, forcing shared context features to preserve fast dynamics while exposing a smoother decision-relevant state.

falsifiable_test.design: Compare raw-target JEPA, denoised-target-only JEPA, dual-target JEPA, and shuffled-denoising controls on equities, Bitcoin, and FX with identical walk-forward splits.
falsifiable_test.primary_metric: held-out downstream state classification at matched latent prediction error
falsifiable_test.failure_condition: Reject if denoised targets improve labels but not held-out economic metrics, or if raw-latent fidelity materially degrades.
